Wazuh Windows Failed Login Detection

A SIEM monitoring lab where a Windows 11 endpoint reports to a Wazuh Manager in VirtualBox. Detects failed logins (Event ID 4625) with Wazuh rule 60122, and includes a custom rule (100100) for repeated attempts, currently under testing.
